p: singular vow: As of his son or daughter.
thy estimation: Who art the priest.
shekels of silver: Read the value of the shekel in Ex 30:13.
month old even unto five years: He speaks of those vows by which the fathers dedicated their children to God who were not of such force; but they might be redeemed from them.
than thy estimation: If he is not able to pay according to your estimate.
holy: That is, consecrate to the Lord.
homer of barley seed shall be: Homer is a measure containing ten ephahs, read of an ephah in Ex 16:16,36.
sold the field to another man: For their own necessity or godly uses.
holy unto the LORD: That is, who dedicate to the Lord with a curse to him that turns it to his private use, Nu 21:2, De 13:15, Jos 9:17.
thine estimation in that day: The priests evaluation.
LORD'S: It was the Lord's already.
put to death: It shall remain without redemption.
fifth part thereof: Besides the value of the thing itself.
rod: All that which is numbered: that is, every tenth as he falls by tale without exception or respect.
